lines.en: This machine is new. How do I start it?
First, put the dirty clothes in, Mom.
I put them in. The basket is empty now.
Now put in soap and push this button.
lines.ko: 이제 비누를 넣고 이 버튼을 눌러요.

lines.en: Which button? There are so many.
The big one. Push it and wait.
Yesterday I washed the laundry by hand.
That's hard work. This machine will always help you.
lines.ko: 힘든 일이에요. 이 기계가 항상 도와줄 거예요.

lines.en: When it's done, will you fold the clothes?
Sure. I always fold them with you.
I cleaned the whole house this morning.
It looks great. Did you sweep the floor today?
lines.ko: 아주 좋아 보여요. 오늘 바닥도 쓸었어요?

lines.en: Yes. I swept and wiped the windows before lunch.
lines.ko: 네. 점심 전에 쓸고 창문도 닦았어요.

lines.en: The trash basket is full. I will take it out.
lines.ko: 쓰레기통이 가득 찼어요. 내가 내다 버릴게요.

lines.en: Thank you. The bag is heavy. Be careful.
Is the trash always this heavy?
Yes. Let's use a smaller bag next time.
lines.ko: 네. 다음에는 더 작은 봉지를 써요.

lines.en: Good idea. Where is the dirty laundry?
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 더러운 빨래는 어디 있어요?

lines.en: In the basket by the machine.
I will wash it after I come back.
